title: Standard Gaussian density on the plane
statement: For $u,v\in\mathbb{R}$, define the standard Gaussian density on the plane by $\rho(u,v)=\frac{1}{2\pi}\exp\!\left(-\frac{u^2+v^2}{2}\right)$, viewed as a nonnegative extended-real-valued function.
